messages:
sarah_support: acme-inc reported structured/json streaming responses sometimes arrive without closing bracket or trailing object — parse errors on client. Happens ~1/4 of requests, region eu-west-1 on hosted. Customer pasted cURL + logs.

Tim: can you add a minimal curl we can run?

sarah_support: sure, reproduced by customer:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate/stream \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","structured":true,"input":"List items as JSON array"}'
```

julia_devex: quick thought — fetch + ReadableStream clients sometimes abort on first parse error and don't drain socket. Could be client-side abort or intermediary cutting connection. Any proxy/cdn in path?

Tim: checked app logs for our side: many connections show TCP FIN from upstream after last chunk: `recv()==0` and then we don't get a subsequent flush for final "]". Suspect proxy (customer uses Fastly -> nginx) trimming final chunk on keepalive close. Repro using repeated loop (curl + jq) useful.

sarah_support: customer confirms Fastly + nginx on their side. They also see this when mobile network drops briefly. They tried SDK with AbortController on timeout.

Tim: actionable repro — run this loop till you hit a failure:
```
while true; do 
  curl -sS -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","structured":true,"input":"[1,2,3]\n"}' \
    https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate/stream | jq '.' || break
  sleep 0.2
done
```
If jq fails and curl exits early, capture tcpdump on client: `sudo tcpdump -i any -w trace.pcap port 443`.

infra-bot: FYI nginx/nginx-ingress 1.24.0 -> 1.24.3 rolled 2026-03-10, includes chunked flush fixes for certain proxies.

Tim: temporary mitigation — add heartbeat tokens in-stream every 10s so proxies keep the connection open and clients don't close early, and add server-side final flush on connection close. We'll instrument server to always send `\n}]\\n` as last flush even on connection reset.

kelly_csm: communicated workaround to customer: disable streaming (use non-stream endpoint) until we release patch, or add client retry logic to re-fetch missing tail.

sarah_support: escalating to eng-runtime to add extra flush and produce a small patch. Sending customer logs, repro steps, and pcap. Thanks all :pray:
